fact: A parametric insurance product underwritten by the DRC Ministry of Agriculture under the PNDA, relying on indices from satellite rainfall data (TAMSAT and ERA5), was launched in 2025 for up to 300,000 farmers in three pilot provinces, with compensation triggered automatically when satellite data crosses thresholds.
title: AXA Climate contributes to the launch of the first climate insurance product designed to protect farmers in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC)
